newsitem.title: USA: FP&L shutting Turkey Pt 3 power station.
newsitem.headline: FP&L shutting Turkey Pt 3 power station.

text.p: Florida Power & Light Co (FPL) is in the process of shutting down its 666 megawatt (MW) Turkey Point 3 nuclear power station in Florida City, Fla., the Nuclear Regulatory Commission reported Tuesday.
The decision to shut the unit was taken after two fuel rods dropped into the reactor early Tuesday, according to the NRC report, which is based on status reports from the plant's operator.
No explanation was given for why the fuel rods dropped.
The plant is currently producing at about 20 percent power.
Turkey Point 3 is one of four nuclear power stations operated by FP&L. The units have an overall generating capacity of about 3,000 MW.
